newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA CENTRAL BANK RAISES 3-MTH T-BILL RATE.
newsitem.headline: MANILA CENTRAL BANK RAISES 3-MTH T-BILL RATE.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Wednesday it had raised its three-month special series Treasury bill rate to 14.00 percent from 13.90 percent.
The rate increase came a day after it cut the rate from 14.20 percent in step with the declining auction rates.
"The central bank is sending mixed signals," a trader said, adding the central bank may have changed its rate because of the persisting volatility in the region's currency markets.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
